deviation: The 90-day warranty runs from "delivery or acceptance", which can start the clock at delivery and shorten the protected period if acceptance testing takes time. Clause 8.4 adds a blanket disclaimer of all other warranties, express or implied, which the playbook prohibits. The "in all material respects" qualifier on SOW conformity is also a minor softening.
suggested_text: 8.1 Mutual. Each Party warrants that it has the authority to enter into and perform this Agreement. 8.2 Services Warranty. Helix warrants that the Services will be performed with reasonable skill and care and will conform to the applicable Statement of Work. 8.3 Remedy. Helix shall correct or re-perform any non-conforming Services or Deliverables free of charge for ninety (90) days after Arcadia's acceptance of the relevant Deliverable. This remedy does not limit Arcadia's other rights or remedies under this Agreement or at law where correction is not achieved within a reasonable time. [Delete 8.4. If a disclaimer is unavoidable, limit it to: "Nothing in this Agreement excludes or limits any warranty, condition, or liability that cannot be excluded by law."]
